description: This Java source file implements the 'iterate' operation for a mini-language within the Apache OFBiz framework. It defines the Iterate class, which handles iteration over collections, entity lists, or iterators, executing nested operations for each element. It also includes metadata validation, error handling, and a factory for creating instances of the class.

classes.name: Iterate
classes.description: Implements the <iterate> element for executing a set of sub-operations over elements of a collection, entity list, or iterator, with support for break and continue statements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Iterates over the specified collection or list, executing nested operations for each element, handling break and continue, and restoring state afterward.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested operations for documentation or analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the iterate element, including its 'entry' and 'list' attributes.
